name: Navigate services and request an estimate
description: Verifies a visitor can navigate to services and prepare an estimate request through the contact form.
steps: Open the Services section from the navigation
Scroll to the estimate request form
Enter a name, phone number, choose Roof repair, and submit
expected: The service content is visible and submitting the valid form opens a mailto draft containing the entered request details.

name: Call the roofing company from contact details
description: Verifies phone contact is available through the site's visible call actions on mobile.
steps: Open the site at a mobile viewport
Tap the fixed Call Hunter & Sons action
expected: The browser is directed to the telephone link for +18133204600.

name: Prevent submitting an incomplete estimate request
description: Verifies the estimate request form requires a name and phone number before it can be submitted.
steps: Navigate to the estimate request form
Leave the required name and phone fields empty
expected: The browser blocks submission and indicates that required fields must be completed.
